title: Кухня без капитана  (A Kitchen Without Its Captain)

segments.t: Using a bundle of broom twigs to illustrate team unity, Nagiyev urges the cooks to work as if Viktor Petrovich were still in the kitchen. When Vika warns that banquet guests are already canceling without Barinov at the helm, Nagiyev orders everyone to keep the Chef's hospitalization a strict secret.
Простой веник.
Как будто он здесь с нами по-прежнему.
Дмитрий Владимирович.
Как прежде, боюсь, не получится.
Сегодня гости уже отказались от банкета.
Что готовить будет не Виктор Петрович.
Наваливаемся и работаем с полной отдачей.
Ты где был?
Полы мыли.
Мы с Настей это тоже.
Белье погладить.
Это Настя придумала.
Что я тебе об этом сказал.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
Простой веник.
'Just an ordinary broom.' With the moment and banquet in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Как будто он здесь с нами по-прежнему.
'As if he were still right here with us.' Pointing out that as if he were still right here with them gives Barinov a sobering reality check.
Дмитрий Владимирович.
'Dmitriy Vladimirovich.' Over the moment and the banquet, Nastya answers Barinov without a second thought.
Как прежде, боюсь, не получится.
'I am afraid things will not work the way they used to.' Once he is afraid things will not work the way they used, Barinov can finally tell Nastya what he means.
Сегодня гости уже отказались от банкета.
'Today guests have already canceled their banquet.' Noting that today guests have already canceled their banquet keeps Vika's side of the story simple and clear.
Что готовить будет не Виктор Петрович.
'Because Viktor Petrovich will not be doing the cooking.' Even though because Viktor Petrovich will not be doing the cooking, Nastya keeps a steady face in front of Barinov.
Наваливаемся и работаем с полной отдачей.
'We all pitch in and work at full capacity.' Over the moment and the point, Barinov answers Nastya without a second thought.
Ты где был?
'Where were you?' By wondering where Barinov was, Vika presses Barinov for a straight answer.
Полы мыли.
'We were mopping the floors.' Once they were mopping the floors, Nastya can finally tell Barinov what she means.
Мы с Настей это тоже.
'Nastya and I did that too.' Adding that Nastya and he did fills in the missing piece for Nastya. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Белье погладить.
'Ironing the laundry.' With the conversation and secret in play, Vika keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Это Настя придумала.
'Nastya came up with that idea.' Since Nastya came up with that idea, Nastya does not waste words on excuses. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Что я тебе об этом сказал.

'Why did I even tell you about that.' Mentioning that why did he even tells Nastya moves the talk in a new direction. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Простой веник.
Как будто он здесь с нами по-прежнему.
Дмитрий Владимирович.
Как прежде, боюсь, не получится.
Сегодня гости уже отказались от банкета.
Что готовить будет не Виктор Петрович.
Наваливаемся и работаем с полной отдачей.
Ты где был?
Полы мыли.
Мы с Настей это тоже.
Белье погладить.
Это Настя придумала.
Что я тебе об этом сказал.
That wraps up this scene as nagiyev uses a broomstick parable to rally the cooks while Vika warns him that banquet guests are already canceling after hearing Chef Barinov is away. Until next time!
До встречи!
